## REQ-RES-DATA-001

**Data DataSets follow the OPC UA JSON DataSet rules**

The Payload of a Data DataSetMessage is an application-defined DataSet whose fields are encoded as JSON DataSet fields of OPC UA PubSub (REQ-MSG-030, REQ-MSG-031). When the component supports the resource Metadata (REQ-CMP-037), the fields are described by the Metadata of the same Source and Tag.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component publishes Data (REQ-CMP-036).
- Refs: MG 8.3.4, MG 9.1.4, SF-077
- Verification: d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.4-b5d32f38, MG-9.1.4-a7f190f6

> Each data object might look different, but it must follow the rules that the OPC Foundation has defined for JSON encoded PubSub DataSets (OPC UA Part 14-7.2.5.4 with the field encoding of Part 6-5.4).
> — MG 8.3.4

> Each data object might look different, but it must follow the rules of OPC Foundation's specification for JSON coded pub/sub DataSets (OPC UA Part 14-7.2.5.4 with the field encoding of Part 6-5.4).
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: Part 14 7.2.5.4 (JSON DataSetMessage) and Part 6 5.4 as fixed for OI4 by REQ-MSG-030/031 (reference corrected by SF-077 (a)). The field values can only be checked against the Metadata of the DataSet.

## REQ-RES-DATA-002

**The standardized process value DataSet Oi4Pv is optional**

A component may offer, per asset, the DataSet Oi4Pv (primary and secondary process values) in addition to its application-defined Data DataSets.

- Keyword: MAY
- Levels: L1 MAY · L2 MAY · L3 MAY
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Refs: MG 8.3.4, MG 9.1.4
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.4-141274c6, MG-9.1.4-691270c1

> The OI4 Alliance defines an optional DataSet to access the available process values in a standard way.
> — MG 8.3.4

> In addition to the application driven DataSets, the OI4 Alliance defines an optional DataSet to access the available process values in a standard way (8.3.4 Data).
> — MG 9.1.4

## REQ-RES-DATA-003

**Oi4Pv is published with the Tag Oi4Pv**

The Oi4Pv DataSet of an asset is published with the Tag Oi4Pv: on Pub/Data/&lt;Source>/Oi4Pv and with the WriterGroupName "Oi4Pv"; no other DataSet uses this Tag.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Oi4Pv (REQ-RES-DATA-002).
- Refs: MG 8.3.4, MG 9.1.4, SF-077
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.4-db9fc005

> The Tag and the WriterGroupName of Oi4Pv are always Oi4Pv, i.e. it must be published via .../Pub/Data/&lt;Source>/Oi4Pv.
> — MG 8.3.4

> To reach this standardized DataSet, the filter Oi4Pv is used for every asset supporting this feature.
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: Like every Data DataSet, Oi4Pv is also contained in the answers to Get/Data/&lt;Source> and Get/Data (REQ-RES-DATA-007; MG 8.3.4 since SF-077 (d)).

## REQ-RES-DATA-004

**Fields of the Oi4Pv DataSet**

The Payload of an Oi4Pv DataSetMessage contains the mandatory field Pv (primary value of the asset) and the optional fields Sv1 … Sv255 (secondary values, the number without leading zeros); each value is a scalar, an array or a JSON object as described by the Metadata of the DataSet; no other field.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Oi4Pv (REQ-RES-DATA-002).
- Refs: MG 8.3.4, SF-077
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.4-0081f2b9, MG-8.3.4-26f6ec09, MG-8.3.4-35fba7b0, MG-8.3.4-9f0a11ec, MG-8.3.4-d7444f35

> Depending on the type of Pv, the value can be a scalar, an array of values or a complex object.
> — MG 8.3.4

> Depending on the type of Sv, the value can be a scalar, an array of values or a complex object.
> — MG 8.3.4

> It must not contain keys other than Pv and Sv&lt;n>.
> — MG 8.3.4

Notes: Sv&lt;n> is optional, &lt;n> is 1 … 255 without leading zeros and secondary values are only present if the asset provides them (MG 8.3.4 since SF-077 (b)).

## REQ-RES-DATA-005

**Measuring point in the description of the Oi4Pv metadata**

The measuring point reflected by Pv and by each Sv&lt;n> (e.g. from the device description of the manufacturer) is given in the Description of the corresponding FieldMetaData of the Oi4Pv Metadata.

- Keyword: SHOULD
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 SHOULD · L3 SHOULD
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Oi4Pv (REQ-RES-DATA-002).
- Refs: MG 8.3.4, SF-077
- Verification: manual
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-8.3.4-07c19d92, MG-8.3.4-61f7039f

> The reflected measuring point, most likely defined by a device description of the manufacturer, should be placed into the Description of the FieldMetaData (8.2.6 FieldMetaData) of Pv in the Metadata of Oi4Pv.
> — MG 8.3.4

> The reflected measuring point, most likely defined by a device description of the manufacturer, should be placed into the Description of the FieldMetaData (8.2.6 FieldMetaData) of Sv&lt;n> in the Metadata of Oi4Pv.
> — MG 8.3.4

Notes: Wording of MG 8.3.4 clarified by SF-077 (c).

## REQ-RES-DATA-006

**Get Data carries no Data object**

A Get Data NetworkMessage contains no Data DataSetMessage; its Messages are empty or contain only the helper DataSets PaginationRequest and Locale.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Scope: MG 8.3.11, MG 8.3.12
- Refs: MG 9.1.4, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-8aea7c70

> In combination with the method Get, the payload requires an empty NetworkMessage. The NetworkMessage can alternatively contain DataSetMessages for PaginationRequest (8.3.11.1 PaginationRequest) and Locale (8.3.12 Locale). A Data object is not included.
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: Data has no Query (GL-ADR-020, REQ-QRY-001). The DataSetClassId of a Get is only sent if the requester knows it (REQ-MSG-011).

## REQ-RES-DATA-007

**Get Data is answered with all addressed DataSets**

A Get Data is answered with every Data DataSet addressed by the topic – without Source all DataSets of all assets of the component, with Source all DataSets of that asset, with Source and Tag that DataSet – each in its own DataSetMessage of a single NetworkMessage published to the corresponding Pub topic.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: responder
- Condition: The component supports the resource Data (REQ-CMP-036).
- Refs: MG 9.1.4
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-0b47ac51, MG-9.1.4-b9fb1fdc

> Via the &lt;Method>/&lt;Resource>[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Filter>]] combination Get/Data[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Tag>]], the publication of this information to the Pub/Data[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Tag>]] topic can be triggered.
> — MG 9.1.4

> A topic such as Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Get/Data must trigger a publication of all available Data information, each in its own DataSetMessage added to a single NetworkMessage and published to the topic Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Pub/Data.
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: Pagination of large answers is REQ-PAG-005, ReplyTo is REQ-MSG-015, the DataSetClassId of the answer REQ-MSG-011 (only if all DataSetMessages belong to one DataSet class). A component without Data answers with an empty list (REQ-CMP-041).

## REQ-RES-DATA-008

**Pub Data carries Data DataSets and optionally Pagination**

A Pub Data NetworkMessage contains Data DataSetMessages and optionally the helper DataSet Pagination; it contains no PaginationRequest and no DataSetMessage of another resource.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: publisher
- Refs: MG 9.1.4, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-3873bdd8

> In combination with the method Pub, the payload contains DataSetMessages of type Data and optional Pagination (8.3.11.2 Pagination).
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: The MG 9.1.4 templates of Pub carry the publisher-defined DataSetClassId of REQ-MSG-011 (since SF-078 (a)).

## REQ-RES-DATA-009

**Set Data addresses exactly one DataSet**

A Set Data is sent to Set/Data/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> and its NetworkMessage contains exactly one Data DataSetMessage – the complete DataSet addressed by the topic; several DataSets cannot be set at once.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Refs: MG 9.1.4, SF-078, SF-079
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-26b77678, MG-9.1.4-6e0f37ae, MG-9.1.4-7beb7760

> In combination with the method Set, the payload contains a single DataSetMessages of type Data. A topic with method Set must contain Resource, Source and Filter to be valid.
> — MG 9.1.4

> Each publication, using the method Set must be done explicitly.
> — MG 9.1.4

> Setting multiple DataSetMessages at once via Oi4v2/&lt;ServiceType>/&lt;AppId>/Set/Data is not possible due to security reasons because it can not be validated via an access control list by the Message Bus.
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: A DataSetMessage always contains all fields of its DataSet (REQ-MSG-030). PublisherId = requester (REQ-MSG-006; MG 9.1.4 Set templates since SF-078 (b)); header of the DataSetMessage per REQ-BUS-010 (MG 8.2.3 since SF-079). Which DataSets are writable is announced by the component (MG B1.1.4 note).

## REQ-RES-DATA-010

**Set Data is protected by ACL**

The operator of the Message Bus prevents Set Data by unauthorized communication participants via the ACL of the broker.

- Keyword: MUST
- Domain: platform · Applies to: broker, platform
- Refs: MG 9.1.4
- Verification: d8
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-04d46451

> To prevent write access by unauthorized communication participants, the operator must prevent this via ACL.
> — MG 9.1.4

## REQ-RES-DATA-011

**Status event after Set Data**

After a Set Data, the component publishes an Event of the category Status about the command on Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> with the Source of the Set topic – mandatory from Level 2 on, recommended at Level 1.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 SHOULD · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for Data.
- Refs: MG 9.1.4, MG 7.4
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-08d8aaf6

> After a Set message arrived, the application must publish an Event message with status information about the Set command to the topic Pub/Event/&lt;Source>/Status/&lt;EventLevel> (8.3.6.1 Status) from compliance Level 2 on and should do so at Level 1 (7.4 Method Element) to provide feedback to the caller.
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: Same obligation as REQ-TOP-014; ReplyTo and content per REQ-RES-EVENT-005. Example MG B1.1.4.

## REQ-RES-DATA-012

**Changed Data is published after a successful Set**

After a successful Set Data, the component publishes the new DataSet to Pub/Data/&lt;Source>/&lt;Tag> with the ReplyTo of the Set.

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: application, device
- Condition: The component offers Set for Data and the Set was successful.
- Refs: MG 9.1.4
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: reviewed
- Inventory: MG-9.1.4-f3328e3d

> If setting Data was successful, the new Data must be published to the Pub/Data[/&lt;Source>[/&lt;Filter>]] topic, according to the settings in PublicationList (8.3.8 PublicationList).
> — MG 9.1.4

Notes: Read like REQ-RES-PUBLIST-025 and REQ-RES-REFDES-010 (reviewed in C-027): the answer to the Set goes to the topic with Source and Tag of the Set; publications configured in the PublicationList follow on their own (REQ-MQTT-019). General rule: REQ-BUS-006.
